annotations.text:
Demo notes

- Countdown runs ~100x real speed (a 25:00 focus phase finishes in ~15s) so you can click through a full cycle. Displayed values (25:00 / 5:00 / 15:00) are the real spec durations.
- Session pips = completed focus sessions this cycle (0-4); the 4th always routes to Long break per AC-04.
- No color-coding by phase, no progress ring, no chime, per spec.md non-goals / open question default - one accent color, plain text labels only.
- Wall-clock reconciliation after backgrounding (US-06/AC-05) is engine logic, not modeled visually here.
